flags.summary: The party has met Cyrus Belview in the castle kitchen (larders_cyrus:first).
Cyrus told the party he cooks for the Master's guests in the cells (quest the_cooks_guests heard).
The party brought Cyrus news of the Belviews at the abbey. He turns friendly and will help Nadia without a roll.
The party told Cyrus what became of the Abbot (reads abbot_fate).
Cyrus told the party he bricked up the wine merchant at the back of the cellar.
Cyrus told the party the lamp over the table of bones drinks from the furnace, and the sluice wheel puts it out.
Cyrus said the holy brother never eats and the Master says leave him be. A no-roll way to unmask Anatol.
Cyrus agreed to smuggle Nadia out at dawn in his scrap barrel (family news, gold, Persuasion or fear).
A failed Persuasion made Cyrus wary: his price for helping Nadia rises from 30 to 80 gp.
A failed Intimidation made Cyrus scream for the watch (larders_watch_alarm). He cowers and won't help. Epilogue may read.
Cyrus told the party the scrap barrel went down the cliff path with Nadia in it.
Someone opened Cyrus's painted box (container flag). He notices once.
Cyrus has complained about his box being opened (once).
The party killed Cyrus Belview (encounter larders_cyrus_fight). The kitchen goes cold. Epilogue may read.
The dead watch is destroyed, in the guardroom (larders_guardroom) or in the kitchen after Cyrus's alarm (larders_watch_alarm).
The lift winch's brake is set (larders_machinery:winch). Opens the lift exit from the larders down to the cells.
The party pulled down the bricks over the wine merchant (larders_cellar:niche): 35 gp, his ledger, and the Tarokka treasure if the reading put one there.
The party took the jailers' keys from the key board in the dungeon (prop flag). Opens Nadia's shackle without a roll.
The three helmed horrors at the jailers' post are destroyed (larders_jailers).
The furnace keepers are destroyed (larders_furnace).
The party turned the sluice wheel and drowned the green furnace (larders_machinery:sluice). The bone lamp goes out and its trap no longer fires.
The Questioner and the things in the drain are destroyed (larders_questioner).
Nadia told the party about the hall of bones, its table and its green lamp.
The party has spoken with Nadia Boteanu in her cell (quest the_cooks_guests found).
Nadia's chain is off (keys, Sleight of Hand or Athletics; quest the_cooks_guests freed).

WHAT BECAME OF NADIA: escaped (out with Cyrus's scrap barrel), sent_alone (ran up the stair alone and was caught), waits (hiding in her cell; lives if Strahd is destroyed). Unset if left chained. The endings' epilogue reads it.
The party found Nadia's shawl folded on the stair (quest the_cooks_guests caught).
The party spoke with Doru, chained in the castle's cells (only if they had let him out of the undercroft).
Doru in the castle: rest (the party ended him at his asking), freed (he attacked: larders_doru_hunger), left (still chained). Donavich's epilogue slide reads it.
Doru was destroyed fighting the party after they freed him (larders_doru_hunger).
The party has spoken with Brother Anatol in his cell.
The party saw that Anatol's breath doesn't fog in the cold (asked how long he's been there). A no-roll way to unmask him.
The party tried the dawn prayer with Anatol (one Religion try).
Brother Anatol: unmasked (seen through; may be left in his cell) or freed (he ambushed the party, who were surprised).
Brother Anatol and his two spawn are destroyed (larders_false_brother or larders_false_brother_unmasked).
